description: Descriptive statistics for one or many numeric series: count / missing, mean, median, mode, range, sample and population variance / SD, standard error, CV, skewness and excess kurtosis (Excel SKEW / KURT), quartiles, IQR, any percentiles (numpy / PERCENTILE.INC), MAD, geometric and harmonic means, a t confidence interval, Tukey outliers and a histogram (numpy "auto" bins). Several named series also get Pearson and Spearman correlation matrices. Accepts numbers, numeric strings, nulls / "NA" (missing) or objects plus a field name. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stats-describe

data.description: Array of numbers, an object of named arrays {"a": [...], "b": [...]}, or an array of objects (with "field")

field.description: Field to read when data is an array of objects (several: comma-separated)
